concerns.text: Task T024 computes a Spectral Density Correlation (SDC) metric, but the specification (FR-003) explicitly requires a Phase Locking Value (PLV) similarity metric. Replacing PLV with SDC weakens the functional requirement and violates the spec.

Task T032 amends the specification to deprecate FR-003 (PLV) and introduce a new FR-003‑SDC. Spec amendments are not a required deliverable and constitute a retroactive narrowing of the original functional requirement, breaking the spec‑to‑tasks traceability.

No task generates or records SHA‑256 checksums of the downloaded MEG and CLUTRR datasets, violating Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) which mandates checksums be recorded in the project state file.

The task list lacks any deliverable that enforces the Single Source of Truth (Constitution Principle IV); there is no explicit step to link each figure or statistic in the final paper to a unique data row and code block, breaking traceability guarantees.

Versioning Discipline (Constitution Principle V) is not addressed: no task records content hashes of generated artifacts in the project's `state/...yaml` file, preventing proper version tracking and stale‑review invalidation.
Task T031 creates a synthetic “toy‑failure” dataset that is not tied to any functional requirement or success criterion, adding unnecessary scope without scientific justification.
